integrity: Proof includes analytical reduction and standalone standard-library exact-rational finite certificate, not a finite search substituted for a universal theorem. Scientific review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: No statement about degree six or above, generalized Laguerre alpha unequal to zero, complex BV norms, or nonlinear approximation. Rigorously positive but narrow fifth-degree winner gap; published priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed literature.
scientific_scope: Sharp real-BV to exponentially weighted L2 spectral truncation error for ordinary Laguerre projections of degrees zero through five, with exact isolation of all global single-jump extremizers.
title: The first global jump relocation in exponential Laguerre spectral approximation
